head: Gardener's Pocket Book makes a planting calendar from your ZIP code
dek: Enter your ZIP code and Gardener's Pocket Book finds your USDA hardiness zone and builds a month-by-month planting calendar for nearly 200 vegetables, herbs, fruits, flowers, trees and shrubs. It was #33 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 6 November.
details: It came out on 5 November and costs $4.99, by Lake James Buzbee.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, $4.99; US ZIP codes
means: If you never know when to plant what, it tells you for your area.
todo: Find Gardener's Pocket Book in the App Store.
thumb_words: WHEN TO PLANT, BY ZIP CODE
